title: Stereo2Spatial: Upmixing Stereo Music to 7.1.4 Spatial Audio with Flow-Matching Diffusion
hook: A hobbyist project trains a flow-matching diffusion model to turn ordinary stereo music into full 7.1.4 spatial mixes — built on a dedicated VAE latent space rather than working directly on audio.
key_points: Goal: upmix regular stereo music into 7.1.4-channel spatial mixes, since most existing music has no real spatial mix.
Core model is a flow-matching diffusion model operating in the latent space of a separately-trained VAE (EAR-VAE), not raw audio.
The stereo input is encoded into one latent, then each of the 7.1.4 output channels is encoded separately.
Design is similar in spirit to ImmersiveFlow, another stereo-to-spatial project the author cites as a reference point.
content_html: A solo project released on r/MachineLearning tackles a real gap in music listening: most tracks only ever get a stereo mix, so there's little content available for people who want to listen in spatial audio. The author spent about six months building Stereo2Spatial, a model that upmixes ordinary stereo tracks into full 7.1.4 spatial mixes.
extra_html: Under the hood, it's a flow-matching diffusion model that operates in the latent space of a separately trained VAE (called EAR-VAE) rather than directly on the waveform — the stereo input gets encoded to one latent, and each channel of the 7.1.4 output is handled separately. The author points to ImmersiveFlow, another stereo-to-spatial project, as a similar-design reference point they drew on. Posted to r/MachineLearning, July 2026 — see the thread for the project link.

flashcards.prompt: What kind of generative model does Stereo2Spatial use to go from stereo to spatial audio?
flashcards.back_html: A flow-matching diffusion model, operating not on raw audio but in the latent space of a separately trained VAE (EAR-VAE).

flashcards.prompt: Why train a separate VAE (EAR-VAE) instead of running the diffusion model directly on raw audio?

choices.text: To do diffusion in a compact learned latent space rather than the raw waveform
Because raw audio can't be represented as vectors at all
To skip training a diffusion model entirely

flashcards.explanation_html: Working in a VAE's latent space is a common diffusion-model pattern: it compresses the signal into a smaller, more tractable representation before the diffusion process operates on it.

flashcards.prompt: What output format does Stereo2Spatial upmix stereo tracks into?
flashcards.explanation_html: The project targets 7.1.4 spatial output, encoding the stereo input to one latent and each output channel separately before decoding.
